text.text_excerpt: Wow so delish! I wish I lived closer to this restaurant b/c I would eat here every day. Seriously!! I tried the beef pho only but I wish I had had room for one of the Banh Mi's. The gals sitting next to me said they are the best in the city. Note to self - must get back here ASAP AND bring the BF. The pho broth was seriously so rich and the meat was fresh and not too fatty. The noodles were perfect too and I rarely eat all the noodles in the bow but I finished this one. The location is great, the atmosphere is very nice and the employees are super friendly. Please give this place a shot. It is worth your time.

Perfect place to get your Asian fusion - Vietnamese fix! I work in the area and by the area I mean I can hear what music the staff is listening to when they're prepping food in the mornings lol. So I don't have to travel far for this option. The staff is nice and the service is good. The food doesn't disappoint as well. I'll start with the crab dip. It's kind of like an open face crab Rangoon. The fried chips are amazing and the dip is creamy and sweet. A little too sweet for my liking but good none the less. The bang bang shrimp is a hit. Honestly I could inhale about five of them and be content. Maybe eight, but who's counting. The pho was good but not the highlight of my visit. The bro...

Em Trai! Thank you for being a tasty option that is walking distance from my house! Thank you for being vegan-friendly! Thank you for both quick fast casual service and easy takeout! Finally, thank you most of all for the superb customer service! It's not just sandwiches, by the way. On a chilly fall day, pho was on my brain. The place was buzzing on a mid week afternoon. Clearly it's a favorite in the neighborhood and with good reason. Service is friendly and accommodating (more on this shortly) and the space is welcoming and quite open.
